data.one_liner: Easily show material update dialogs or Cupertino dialogs with native Android in-app update support.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to intelligently detect new app versions on Google Play and the Apple App Store. Provides native in-app updates for Android (immediate or flexible) and customizable Flutter dialogs or full-screen update pages for iOS or cross-platform usage.
use_when: You want to prompt users to update their app from Google Play or Apple App Store.
You need native Android in-app updates (immediate or flexible flows).
You want to enforce minimum app versions using store descriptions.
avoid_when: Your app targets platforms other than Android and iOS.
You do not publish your app to official app stores.
strengths: Supports both native Android in-app updates and custom cross-platform Flutter UI.
Detailed error handling mapping to platform update and network error types.
Minimum version enforcement via store descriptions.
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platforms only.
Requires proper store configuration and published store IDs to function fully.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android compileSdkVersion 36, minSdkVersion 23, and Java JVM target 17.
